scenario.name: pick_place_table
scenario.doc: Baseline VLA pick-and-place: one work table in front of the robot with four named objects on it, a packing table 2.5 m away with a tote to place into. This is the scene the rest of the system was developed against (same table geometry and heights as the original models/g1_pick_place.xml), rebuilt out of the object library so that object identity, colour and pose can be randomised. Use it for "pick the green cube and put it in the tote".
